stage0057_04:r_caaab7bad760e16d.text:
$$バルトフェルド$$
「This is bad, this...!」

stage0057_04:r_99b162aa6aa286a2.text:
$$メイリン$$
「We're all right, $$バルトフェルド$$!
　$c has arrived!」

stage0057_04:r_1c0f94acd5a8a143.text:
$$リディ$$
「It may prove the boundary isn't fully fixed,
　but this many in a row is no cause to cheer!」

stage0057_04:r_3bc300bbdc277d82.text:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「What...! You mean just us have to fight!?」

stage0057_04:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
$$シン$$
「Get back, all of you!
　$$ザフト$$ exists to protect $$プラント$$!」

stage0057_04:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
$$アルト$$
「Stop it, $$シン$$!
　Dealing with the Vajra comes first right now!」

stage0057_04:r_ec335e69f984b8b3.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Focus on what's in front of you.
　At this rate, $$プラント$$ will come
　under attack from the Vajra.」

stage0057_04:r_f951916061232dcd.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「We're fine without $$アンディ$$!
　We'll manage somehow with who's left!」

stage0057_04:r_da2132b5038ec737.text:
$$オズマ$$
「All units, intercept the Vajra!
　Don't let them near $$プラント$$!」

stage0057_04:r_495d61d3ec7e16f2.text:
$$カイエン$$
「Is that the last of them...」

stage0057_04:r_a653c8dec4c0f06f.text:
$$シン$$
「Bad news!
　We're close to $$プラント$$!」

stage0057_04:r_86d493e37a9799a7.text:
$$バナージ$$
「At this rate, the colony's...!」

stage0057_04:r_09d0fcc600cdd3df.text:
$$カイエン$$
「Damn it!
　These guys don't quit!」

stage0057_04:r_182faded068c15ed.text:
$$バナージ$$
「At this rate, the colony's going to...!」

stage0057_04:r_d60d0818e965232f.text:
$$イズモ$$
「$$ミカゲ$$...
　Sending a trans-dimensional life form
　under the pretense of backing me up...」

stage0057_04:r_6fd86c96891ea942.text:
$$モロイ$$
「The Altair army!
　Attacking with such a small force!」

stage0057_04:r_43e4e548c0b28376.text:
$$サザンカ$$
「But there's a machine I've never seen!」

stage0057_04:r_d80a9688790ed583.text:
$$イズモ$$
（Vega, of my youth...
　I've come back...）

stage0057_04:r_708bea61e3c43ada.text:
$$シュレード$$
「A tone I've never heard before...
　Heavy, and noble...」

stage0057_04:r_0827963cfd706e8d.text:
$$桂$$
「Just what it sounds like.
　That white one's the enemy boss, I'd say!」

stage0057_04:r_ff6f8bdca2dd2bc9.text:
$$オズマ$$
「More pressure than that beast of a man!
　He's no ordinary one!」

stage0057_04:r_3f4035fd9db81258.text:
$$イズモ$$
「So someone can sense my aura...
　Then I'll test that power myself!」

stage0057_04:r_d22851aaafbbf8fc.text:
$$イズモ$$
「Here I come, warriors of Vega!
　Altair's $$イズモ$$ approaches!」

stage0057_04:r_79f2664edb1af798.text:
$$カイエン$$
「No ordinary skill, that's for sure.
　But beat us bare-handed? Not a chance!」

stage0057_04:r_a62c4e7f3c09f7ed.text:
$$イズモ$$
「I see.
　I've got a good measure of your skill.」

stage0057_04:r_53bb64ee17750ee2.text:
$$カイエン$$
「$$アマタ$$!
　Let's finish him off!」

stage0057_04:r_b2befefdbed1393d.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「Keep your distance and he's nothing to fear!」

stage0057_04:r_2103f6df2ea2e447.text:
$$アマタ$$
「All right!
　Here goes, Mugen Attack!!」

stage0057_04:r_91bf33c27ad39f0a.text:
$$イズモ$$
「The energy I took from you!
　Here it comes back!」

stage0057_04:r_c304df6888eb78f7.text:
$$イズモ$$
「Still green...
　I'll credit you that much drive, at least.」

stage0057_04:r_cdb750c9d380881a.text:
$$キラ$$
「He's firing our own attack energy back...!?」

stage0057_04:r_95fda74613c97b39.text:
$$ガムリン$$
「So that's his real power!」

stage0057_04:r_0ebc5a6f1e0f81bf.text:
$$キラ$$
「I won't let you have $$プラント$$!」

stage0057_04:r_6bbd5a3c5afb87e0.text:
$$キラ$$
「I decided I'd protect it, no matter what!
　I...!」

stage0057_04:r_32eb462c1b4999cb.text:
$$バナージ$$
「It's like... a wrathful god!」

stage0057_04:r_1f4337d6d393fc37.text:
$$キラ$$
「I won't let it happen...!
　I will protect it, no matter what!」

stage0057_04:r_b76524cd840e1d37.text:
$$イズモ$$
（I too... once risked my life
　to protect someone, just like him...）

stage0057_04:r_bfb27f9eb2f7073e.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Wait!
　I sense no hostile intent from that man...!」

stage0057_04:r_71ebf05996a4b0fd.text:
$$イズモ$$
「People of this colony,
　and you, $c, who have turned back
　our assaults time and again, hear this.」

stage0057_04:r_6214c11b1bca811e.text:
$$イズモ$$
「I am Altair's Commander, $$イズモ・カムロギ$$.
　I have no intention of fighting further.」

stage0057_04:r_2113dcbabdfc758a.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Wait!
　I sense no hostile intent from that man...!」

stage0057_04:r_6a74519e1fc29c4b.text:
$$イズモ$$
「People of this colony,
　and you, $c, who have turned back
　our assaults time and again, hear this.」

stage0057_04:r_5b992878fee054b5.text:
$$イズモ$$
「I am Altair's Commander, $$イズモ・カムロギ$$.
　I have no intention of fighting further.」

stage0057_04:r_4a14ec0c511c7f0d.text:
$$ブライト$$
「A Commander...
　to think he'd come to the field himself...」

stage0057_04:r_20cf167c0ec0d4d5.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Does he mean to negotiate with us?」

stage0057_04:r_b591d812c96c6c99.text:
$$イズモ$$
「That's right.
　I have no wish for needless bloodshed.」

stage0057_04:r_fb05d8e5f1ee93e5.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Wait, $n.
　If this fight with Altair, who holds
　transfer tech, can end in talks, all the better.」

stage0057_04:r_c33bd700553abf91.text:
$$カイエン$$
「But, Captain $$アムロ$$!
　They've been abducting women from our world!」

stage0057_04:r_feee5c91826230e1.text:
$$イズモ$$
「Your anger is understandable.
　But we have our reasons to desire
　this world's women... $$イグラー$$s.」

stage0057_04:r_bccc48e1964ad22d.text:
$$イズモ$$
「And the reason I've come here now
　is to seek out the strongest $$レア・イグラー$$.」

stage0057_04:r_f8736aaaa216c766.text:
$$バナージ$$
「The strongest $$レア・イグラー$$...?」

stage0057_04:r_d1ec2522c87c361d.text:
$$桂$$
「Not sure I get it,
　but it's their ideal woman or something.」

stage0057_04:r_3599f0a4343fd95c.text:
$$イズモ$$
「I've come to fetch the $$レア・イグラー$$ known
　as the songstress who lives in this colony.」

stage0057_04:r_94a88c90e557e16e.text:
$$イズモ$$
（$$アリシア$$ was a singer too...
　$$ミカゲ$$'s reasoning does make sense.）

stage0057_04:r_5b7ee307a700171a.text:
$$シン$$
「I don't know your reasoning,
　but don't think you can use people as you please!」

stage0057_04:r_8d8f065c932da30a.text:
$$イズモ$$
「I see...
　So you refuse my wish.」

stage0057_04:r_f5432119677514f7.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Forced with a one-sided demand,
　we have no choice but to respond this way.」

stage0057_04:r_4e5c8e989c4a7691.text:
$$ブライト$$
「First, I'd like to hear your side of things.
　Then we'll consider how to respond.」

stage0057_04:r_c17c58fdba72005e.text:
$$イズモ$$
「There are other $$レア・イグラー$$ candidates...」

stage0057_04:r_1fe8564d2b959317.text:
$$イズモ$$
「It's the one who rides the Mechanical Angel!」

stage0057_04:r_4b1247bd3ca4905d.text:
$$アマタ$$
「You mean $$ミコノ$$ and the others!?」

stage0057_04:r_00c55e25f87b71d0.text:
$$イズモ$$
「The Mechanical Angel that's turned back
　Altair's warriors... its pilot alone is fit
　to bear the name of strongest $$レア・イグラー$$.」

stage0057_04:r_338f3b27e51dcc41.text:
$$ユノハ$$
「So that's why $$ジン$$ was after me...」

stage0057_04:r_d91d4bc2d52b61c4.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「$$カイエン$$!
　Pull the female Elements back!」

stage0057_04:r_0c8ea89b07432421.text:
$$カイエン$$
「Understood!
　Let's go, $$シュレード$$!」

stage0057_04:r_4dbfba00ba7744ee.text:
$$シュレード$$
「Just what I wanted, my friend!」

stage0057_04:r_702f82442fcec8a9.text:
$$アマタ$$
「It's all right, $$ミコノ$$!
　We'll protect everyone!」

stage0057_04:r_b1e38da4e8775ffe.text:
$$カイエン$$
「As a man, and as a brother!」

stage0057_04:r_d2f1bf5ab2f0e41a.text:
$$シュレード$$
「Heh... an all-male Energico isn't so bad,
　once in a while.」

stage0057_04:r_2acc8ade0cc6dfa2.text:
$$イズモ$$
「Good spirit.
　That's the way, men of Vega.」

stage0057_04:r_3dad695c99e9e052.text:
$$イズモ$$
「But I bear
　the responsibility of Altair's Commander!
　Anyone who hinders that duty, I will remove!」

stage0057_04:r_66d4ae3a21caf881.text:
$$オズマ$$
「All units, stay sharp!
　He's not the same as before!」

stage0057_04:r_0c18da7b3a37825d.text:
$$イズモ$$
「Here I come, warriors of Vega!
　I fight for Altair's future!」

stage0057_04:r_63249745ffae61b6.text:
$$イズモ$$
「War has been declared.
　That's enough for today.」

stage0057_04:r_abdb034ae8509702.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「$$アマタ$$!
　Don't let him get away!!」

stage0057_04:r_e51ecf6d6aa42e75.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「What are you talking about!
　If we beat him, our fight with Altair ends,
　and we might break the Prison of Time too!」

stage0057_04:r_b025267f22788233.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「I'll ride the $$ゲパルト$$!
　$$ＭＩＸ$$, I'm counting on you with the $$スパーダ$$!」

stage0057_04:r_7bdb6fecc8b3bde8.text:
$$イズモ$$
「This feeling...!
　Just as I thought, the one piloting it is...!」

stage0057_04:r_4bf9b05b5f948170.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Why not see for yourself, $$イズモ$$?
　With your own eyes...!」

stage0057_04:r_b4bc9e9435b58e6f.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Allow me to lend a hand.」

stage0057_04:r_7cbc63dad295f862.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Mother!
　Why is this illusion here...!」

stage0057_04:r_07f53c816e0a51f5.text:
$$シュレード$$
（Someone's toying with $$アマタ$$'s heartstrings...!
　Pure, sweet, and bitter...）

stage0057_04:r_2d09c6f6a2d990ea.text:
$$イズモ$$
「$$ミカゲ$$...! Such a cunning trick!」

stage0057_04:r_3c5fcfc484a51913.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「But that reaction of his just now...
　surely that's made it clear.」

stage0057_04:r_9af213fc64e0afec.text:
$$イズモ$$
「$$レア・イグラー$$ reading confirmed.
　Recovering it.」

stage0057_04:r_24e1a808a1609a1a.text:
$$ＭＩＸ$$
「$$ゼシカ$$, take better care of yourself.
　I don't want to see you throw yourself away.」

stage0057_04:r_53128ce8f154fd06.text:
$$ＭＩＸ$$
「And tell $$アンディ$$ I'm sorry, too...」

stage0057_04:r_03b5db9ce98fb8d6.text:
$$イズモ$$
「How admirable, risking herself to save a friend...」

stage0057_04:r_3915fb4102f1c1dd.text:
$$イズモ$$
「Our objective is met.
　Let's withdraw, $$ミカゲ$$.」

stage0057_04:r_817b2773b4ed563e.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Very well.
　I gained something too.」

stage0057_04:r_4d2a9066c4e7b27f.text:
$$イズモ$$
「How green you are.
　I can see your youth in the way you fly.」

stage0057_04:r_10340119af3ed6db.text:
$$アルト$$
「He's read through my every move...!」

stage0057_04:r_23a9c7ab620ab112.text:
$$イズモ$$
「Confidence in one's own power is youth's privilege.
　But when faced with a greater power still,
　it is then one's true worth is tested.」

stage0057_04:r_4f0aca6deda07883.text:
$$アルト$$
「Someone who decides how others should live
　from up high has no right to act like an adult!」

stage0057_04:r_8fe40600ce62dfbc.text:
$$アルト$$
「I'll strip that composure right off you!」

stage0057_04:r_ff4ce5f3cf96b617.text:
$$イズモ$$
「Then let me teach you the difference
　between reckless bravery and true courage!」

stage0057_04:r_d73c21f119847e35.text:
$$バサラ$$
「If the big boss came out himself, this'll be quick!
　I'll teach you how pointless war really is!」

stage0057_04:r_89766f5ffaa912d4.text:
$$イズモ$$
「Quite a song.
　It's setting my heart on fire.」

stage0057_04:r_451f726d4299ea35.text:
$$イズモ$$
「But I have a mission!
　Before it, I set aside all personal feeling!」

stage0057_04:r_e3d111e8bb190cb1.text:
$$バサラ$$
「Living with a lid on your own heart is stupid!
　I'll blast it away with my song!」

stage0057_04:r_7c0d3c51f9a11ca0.text:
$$桂$$
「A guy who snatches girls for his own convenience
　is, any way I look at it, my enemy...!」

stage0057_04:r_ab97c2b2418ea732.text:
$$イズモ$$
「I ask for no understanding...!
　I simply carry out my mission!」

stage0057_04:r_2ddff5064af78db4.text:
$$桂$$
「You're way too stiff!
　Can't you see that way of doing things
　just breeds resistance!」

stage0057_04:r_050d0532c4b24bfe.text:
$$桂$$
「Looks like I'll have to personally teach you
　how to treat a girl!」

stage0057_04:r_f228ae702350849b.text:
$$イズモ$$
「Just as I thought...
　I had a feeling, and it seems I was right...」

stage0057_04:r_d69dc027cba3003f.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Stop talking nonsense...!
　Here I come!!」

stage0057_04:r_3c3735172a480b72.text:
$$イズモ$$
「Come then, boy with wings!
　I will cast aside everything for my mission!」

stage0057_04:r_1f418b5594cea300.text:
$$イズモ$$
「Fine skill you have.
　With more experience, you'll be a fine warrior.」

stage0057_04:r_f87fb889124bfaef.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「This man... stronger than any Altair soldier yet!」

stage0057_04:r_79c90de32a79212d.text:
$$イズモ$$
「But meeting me here is your misfortune...!
　If you won't yield, prepare yourself to die!」

stage0057_04:r_33f7fd55913419e8.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「A threat like that...!
　I won't just go down quietly either!」

stage0057_04:r_473d9a88b4ca96e7.text:
$$イズモ$$
「This man... one of Vega's finest warriors!」

stage0057_04:r_4de6ac85c63bac12.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Strong...!
　Not just skill, but filled with an iron will!」

stage0057_04:r_4c92652c9b1adf6f.text:
$$イズモ$$
「Did you feel my resolve...!
　Simply fighting a man such as you
　made coming to Vega worth it!」

stage0057_04:r_ce90563a934d49fb.text:
$$イズモ$$
「Even one still green now,
　if they hold the potential to threaten Altair,
　I will crush them here!」

stage0057_04:r_4fb296e63cb1fb46.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Attacking with your own self-serving logic,
　then spouting more of the same here...!」

stage0057_04:r_6d77e72dbbcd7dfe.text:
$$バナージ$$
「I can't let someone like that
　have their way!」

stage0057_04:r_9dc59affd40f32fc.text:
$$シン$$
「Just because you kept losing on Earth,
　now you're after the $$プラント$$s!」

stage0057_04:r_0cea115be526a319.text:
$$イズモ$$
「Good spirit.
　Seems you have what a warrior needs most.」

stage0057_04:r_d36072babd12aeb4.text:
$$シン$$
「That composure won't last much longer!
　Get ready!」

stage0057_04:r_09ee921a85025fd3.text:
$$イズモ$$
「But you're much too green...!
　Momentum alone won't be enough to fell me!」

stage0057_04:r_fae689f2a1057b61.text:
$$イズモ$$
「Good movement...!
　You're no ordinary warrior!」

stage0057_04:r_91c6d0bb53854ecc.text:
$$キラ$$
「This man... unlike any enemy so far...!」

stage0057_04:r_42a3149105314ab8.text:
$$イズモ$$
「Such calm fighting hides a burning heart...!
　Seems there's someone worth protecting
　on that colony!」

stage0057_04:r_62ecd978c667bd29.text:
$$キラ$$
「You're right about that.
　That's why I'll stop you here...!」

stage0057_04:r_d441e6cc908ac01b.text:
$$キラ$$
「To protect someone precious to me!」

stage0057_04:r_b2aab8873350ea1f.text:
$$イズモ$$
「Rough as you are, I sense a spark of talent...!
　So this is youth!」

stage0057_04:r_2c7af4c55d8ac938.text:
$n
「Trying to play the critic?
　Or just a pose to hide your own impatience?」

stage0057_04:r_653b741d07545dff.text:
$$イズモ$$
「Heh... rude of me, toward one giving their all.」

stage0057_04:r_d584d4b5af55b1cf.text:
$$イズモ$$
「As an apology for that...!
　I'll strike you down with all I have!」

stage0057_04:r_db0ee69ece206fcd.text:
$n
「Now you're acting like a big shot!?
　Talk like that after you've shut me up!」
